c4a20zfn.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
c4a20zfn.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
c4a20zfn.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree offers a modern seasonal décor solution for any occasion. Its elegant cone shape and versatile green color seamlessly fit into living rooms, gardens, or terraces, providing an eye-catching focal point without overwhelming the setting. Ideal for those who appreciate contemporary style, this thoughtfully designed product ensures ease of setup with its built-in LED lighting, enhancing its decorative appeal. PVC and Steel Construction Engineered with premium PVC, the tree provides a lightweight yet stable structure that withstands the test of time. The steel components augment the tree's sturdiness, ensuring it remains upright, thus facilitating safe and enjoyable decorating sessions. These materials enhance resilience, promising extended use, season after season, with minimal upkeep required. Integrated LED Lights Enjoy the glow of warm white LED lighting that enriches your atmosphere and resonates with the festive spirit. The energy-efficient LED string lights are artfully distributed across the tree, illuminating every branch and providing a radiant charm that is both subtle and captivating without consuming unnecessary power. USB Power Source Equipped with a USB power connector, this tree provides a convenient and modern way to illuminate your festive ambiance. Plug it into any certified 5V USB power source to instantly bless your space with joyful light. This feature enhances portability, allowing easy placement wherever you desire festive illumination. Decorative Convenience Designed for those who relish aesthetic yet functional designs, this tree celebrates the modern minimalistic style. Its ornamental nature infuses spaces with style and warmth, while also offering practical USB compatibility for a simple power connection, which elevates the overall user experience with its ease of use. Dual-Use Design Perfectly poised for both indoor and outdoor settings, this tree adapts effortlessly to different environments, whether it’s a cozy living room retreat or a holiday-themed terrace. Its flexible design allows for imaginative placement and creative decoration solutions, enhancing spaces with festive cheer and contemporary grace. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC and metal Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 110 cm Stand size: 45 x 45 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips with iridescent decorations Reusable, Low maintenance, Simple setup, Sturdy metal stand 8 Lighting modes: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on Number of PVC tips: 910 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: Plug Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
